description:
Encuentra y analiza objetos/arreglos JSON dentro de un texto libre (p. ej. respuesta de un LLM), con reparación opcional. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: extraer bloques de código delimitados (code-blocks-extract). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Finds and parses JSON objects/arrays embedded in free text (e.g. an LLM reply): fenced ```json blocks first, then balanced {…}/[…] spans; optionally repairs near-JSON. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: extracting fenced code blocks (code-blocks-extract). inputSchema.description: EN: Finds and parses JSON objects/arrays embedded in free text (e.g. an LLM reply): fenced ```json blocks first, then balanced {…}/[…] spans; optionally repairs near-JSON. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: extracting fenced code blocks (code-blocks-extract). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

max_results.description: Max results (integer; optional; default 10; min 1; max 100).

repair.description: Try json-repair on spans that fail to parse (boolean; optional; default true).
